## Site structure

- [Home](https://hhfa008.github.io/personal/): Services and pricing, selected work with outcomes, writing and videos, and contact details.
- [Case studies](https://hhfa008.github.io/personal/cases.html): Three anonymized engagements with problem, actions, and measured results.

## Services

- iOS Performance Audit — 1 week, $500–750 fixed — for apps that launch slowly, drop frames in core flows, or show rising memory and crashes. Deliverables: cold and warm launch breakdown, top five jank hotspots with traces, memory peak and leak inventory, prioritized optimization backlog.
- Architecture Review — 1–2 weeks, $1,200–2,000 fixed — for growing codebases, slowing feature delivery, and module boundaries that no longer hold. Deliverables: layering and dependency-direction review, modularization and SPM split proposal, dependency injection and test strategy, phased migration roadmap and risk register.
- Ongoing Contract — weekly, $35/hour, minimum 10 hours per week — embedded with the team for feature delivery, performance escalations, and App Store submission support.

## Selected work

- Live SDK consolidation at ByteDance — led a three-year consolidation of two parallel iOS live SDKs into one shared codebase of 2M+ lines, with roughly 90% lower maintenance cost and zero P3+ incidents.
- 2022 World Cup live delivery — client-side lead coordinating 30+ iOS engineers across 32 live matches, with zero major incidents.
- Live SDK build and integration — reworked the build graph and SDK packaging, cutting full compile time from 50 to 10 minutes and host-app integration from 5 days to 1.
- Wealth-management app from zero — built the Swift architecture and component framework for a 2.2M-user platform, then cut code by 70% through componentization.
